name: filters by neighborhood before choosing an exact fill
input: an otherwise useful property outside the requested neighborhood

name: ranks capacity before property count and count before index ties
input: a lower-capacity pair, a higher-capacity singleton, and equal-capacity alternatives
test:
properties = [
    {'id': 'six-a', 'capacity': 6},
    {'id': 'four', 'capacity': 4},
    {'id': 'eleven', 'capacity': 11},
]
assert best_capacity_subset(properties, 10) == [properties[0], properties[1]]
properties = [
    {'id': 'five-a', 'capacity': 5},
    {'id': 'five-b', 'capacity': 5},
    {'id': 'ten', 'capacity': 10},
]
assert best_capacity_subset(properties, 10) == [properties[2]]
properties = [{'id': 'first', 'capacity': 6}, {'id': 'second', 'capacity': 6}]
assert best_capacity_subset(properties, 6) == [properties[0]]

name: returns an empty subset for zero or infeasible requirements
input: a zero group size and a target beyond all eligible capacity
